subject.title: [security] Tart desktop leases enable host-reachable Screen Sharing with known default credentials

question: Should the immediate Tart desktop safeguard reject the known default credential, or should Crabbox first support proven per-lease credential provisioning before Screen Sharing is enabled?
rationale: This choice determines the security boundary and upgrade behavior for existing desktop users, and safe account-password rotation depends on supported image and access-path compatibility that cannot be inferred from the report alone.

options.title: Fail closed for the shared default
options.body: Refuse desktop acquisition when the effective Tart account password is the known default while continuing to allow an explicitly configured non-default credential.

options.title: Provision unique credentials first
options.body: Generate and install a unique credential before enabling Screen Sharing only after image-compatibility, secret-handling, and desktop-access behavior are demonstrated.

recommendation.title: Fail closed for the shared default
recommendation.body: Refuse desktop acquisition when the effective Tart account password is the known default while continuing to allow an explicitly configured non-default credential.

likelyOwner.reason: The reporter currently has the most detailed evidence for the affected Tart behavior; repository history ownership was not established in the available evidence.
